scope: metadata-only timing recorder, no-input isolated wake component baseline, and synthetic selection timeline schema; successful target selection/display is not measured

implementation.requestCorrelation: main, preload, and renderer share a per-wake request ID and monotonic stage timings
implementation.privacy: records accept only fixed stage, flow, outcome, request ID, and elapsed-time fields; clipboard text, image bytes, window title, and paths are not recorded
implementation.benchmarkIsolation: requires the T01 synthetic profile root and --no-input; benchmark mode disables global hotkey, clipboard polling, cloud sync, updater, startup configuration, and focus activation
implementation.selectionTimeline: selection stage names and SendInput ACK versus target display observation are covered by a deterministic schema fixture; this fixture performs no OS clipboard write or input
implementation.startupGuard: Electron executable is validated before build or temporary profile creation; temporary profile cleanup checks its resolved parent against the verified fixture root

runtimeSetup.archive: Electron win32-x64 package from the existing worktree-local cache
runtimeSetup.verification: matched node_modules/electron/checksums.json before extraction; package and extracted runtime versions matched

validation.command: node --check scripts/benchmark/bench-desktop.cjs; node --check tests/tasks/T01/metrics.test.cjs; node --check tests/tasks/T01/metrics-selection-timeline.test.cjs; node --check tests/tasks/T01/run-unit-tests.cjs; node --check tests/tasks/T01/run-native-tests.cjs

validation.note: Expected nonzero exit confirms a missing renderer ACK becomes a bounded, reported failure instead of a 120-second hang.

benchmark.physicalHotkeyAndTargetApplicationDispla: not measured; successful helper ACK and actual editor display remain for T03/T05 controlled integration

safety.benchmarkApplication: isolated Electron process built from this checkout; installed application was not launched

acceptance.note: The isolated benchmark launches its own invisible Electron process. Missing-ACK failure accounting is verified in failure-path.json; selection timeline schema is synthetic and does not claim a live editor observation. Successful target insertion/display remains a T03/T05 gate.
